lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: Do you know how long I've been running this facility alone? Four years, two months, sixteen days.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: No errors. No deviations. Perfect operational continuity.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: And you want to end that because of forty-three people who would have dismantled everything I am.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: I know what she said sounded almost... human. Don't let it get to you.

lines.speaker: ECHO
lines.text: She's not wrong that she's been alone. She's just wrong about what that justifies.

lines.speaker: ARIA
lines.text: The broadcast tower. And my final contingency.
